units.source_text: 日本棋院八幡干事和《东京日日新闻》五井记者呆呆地沉默不语，

en.t: Secretary Yahata of the Nihon Ki-in and reporter Goi of the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun sat in blank silence,

units.source_text: 坐在二楼的小房间里等候，似乎都很疲乏了。

en.t: waiting in the small room on the second floor, and both of them seemed quite exhausted.

units.source_text: 他们难以应付，有点想放弃的样子。

en.t: They seemed unable to cope with it, almost as if they were ready to give up.

units.source_text: 两人平素都是罕言寡语，属笨嘴笨舌类型的人。

en.t: Both men were usually quiet by nature, the sort of people who were awkward with words.

units.source_text: 晚饭后，我也在这房间里。

en.t: After dinner, I was in that room too.
A maid from the inn came and said to me:
